question.prompt: In right triangle \(ABC\), \(\angle C=90^\circ\), \(BC=6\), and \(\tan A=3/4\). Find the lengths of \(AC\) and \(AB\). (Give your answers in this order, separated by a comma.)

solutions.explanation: From \(\tan A=BC/AC=3/4\), we obtain \(AC=8\). By the Pythagorean theorem, \(AB=\sqrt{36+64}=10\).
solutions.title: Tangent ratio and Pythagorean theorem
